issues.evidence: Local SQLite PoC (`evidence/security-poc-results.json`): Attacker Bob sent `POST /api/collab/trips` with `trip.id = 'trip_alice_secret'`, received `201 {role:'owner'}`, read Alice's private comments & expenses (`200`), restored version 1 (`200`) to retrieve Alice's original trip JSON, and deleted Alice from `trip_members` (`200`).
reproSteps: 1. User A creates private trip `trip_alice_secret` via `POST /api/collab/trips`.
2. User B sends `POST /api/collab/trips` with `{ trip: { id: 'trip_alice_secret', name: 'Hijacked' } }`.
3. User B calls `GET /api/collab/trips/trip_alice_secret` and `POST .../versions/1/restore`.
issues.rootCause: `INSERT INTO trips ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE` overwrites existing trip rows without verifying `trips.owner_id === user.id`, and `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_members` grants the caller `'owner'` role.
issues.impact: Any authenticated user can hijack any known or guessable trip ID, exfiltrate private itineraries/comments/expenses, and lock out the legitimate owner.
issues.fixRecommendation: Reject `POST /api/collab/trips` with `403` when `trips.id` already exists and `owner_id !== user.id` (or always generate server-side `tripId` on `POST` and require `PUT` for updates).
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate `POST /api/collab/trips` with another owner's `trip.id` returns `403 Forbidden`; attacker never appears in `trip_members` and cannot read/modify the trip.
issues.confidenceAndStatus: 高可信度 · 已通过真实 SQLite + Worker PoC 复现确认

issues.evidence: Local SQLite PoC (`evidence/security-poc-results.json`): Owner Alice joined her own viewer invite token via `POST /api/collab/join/:token`; `trip_members.role` changed from `'owner'` to `'viewer'`, and subsequent `POST .../invites` and `PUT` returned `403`.

3. Owner attempts `PUT /api/collab/trips/:id` or `POST .../invites`.
issues.rootCause: `ON CONFLICT(trip_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role=excluded.role` overwrites `'owner'` with `'viewer'`/`'editor'`, and `getMemberRole()` checks `trip_members` before `trips.owner_id`.

issues.fixRecommendation: Check `trip.owner_id === userId` first in `getMemberRole()`, and add `WHERE trip_members.role != 'owner'` (or skip update if owner) in `POST /api/collab/join/:token`.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Owner joining any invite link retains `'owner'` role and `PUT`/invite permissions; editors cannot downgrade owners.

issues.evidence: 600 randomized property trials (`evidence/algorithm-audit-results.json`): `mergeTripDocuments` failed commutativity in 440/600 trials (73.3%) and associativity in 115/600 trials (19.2%); sorts stops alphabetically by `id` (`['s_z','s_a'] -> ['s_a','s_z']`), duplicates cross-day moves, and resurrects deleted stops.

issues.module: Security / Auth Session, OAuth & Account Lifecycle
issues.evidence: Local SQLite PoC (`evidence/security-poc-results.json`): (1) Old session cookie still returned `200 authenticated:true` after `POST /api/auth/reset-password`; (2) 15 consecutive `request-reset` calls got 0 `429`s; (3) Logging into attacker's own account cleared victim's IP lockout across 27 brute-force guesses; (4) Google OAuth accepted `verified_email:false` and kept attacker's pre-registered password active; (5) `DELETE /api/account` left orphan `trips`/`comments`/`expenses` with `PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF`; (6) `avatarUrl` accepted `data:image/svg+xml`.
reproSteps: 1. Sign in as Alice, trigger password reset, replay old `kairos_session` cookie -> still `200`.
2. Fail 9 guesses against victim, log into attacker's account from same IP, repeat -> 27 guesses with zero `429`.
3. Pre-register unverified email, trigger OAuth callback -> old password still logs in.
issues.rootCause: Missing `DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id=?` on password reset; `clearAuthFailures(ip)` resets global IP counter on any valid login and lives in per-isolate `Map`; OAuth trusts unverified Google accounts and preserves pre-existing unverified passwords; D1 lacks per-connection `FK=ON` enforcement and cascade rules on `trip_versions`/`expenses`; `avatarUrl` allows arbitrary `data:image/*` including SVG.
issues.impact: Stolen sessions survive password resets, brute-force throttles are trivially bypassed, unverified accounts are vulnerable to OAuth pre-takeover, deleted users leave orphaned PII, and SVG data URLs pose stored XSS risk if rendered inline.
issues.fixRecommendation: Revoke all `sessions` on password reset; key rate limits on `(ip, email)` via Cloudflare Rate Limiting / Turnstile / Durable Objects without clearing victim counters; require `verified_email===true` and clear unverified `password_hash`/sessions in OAuth; explicitly delete all user tables in `DELETE /api/account` batch; disallow `image/svg+xml` in `avatarUrl`.
issues.reusableOpenSource: Cloudflare Turnstile / Workers Rate Limiting API + Zod
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Password reset invalidates all prior sessions; 10 failed logins for an email lock regardless of other logins; OAuth checks `verified_email`; `DELETE /api/account` leaves 0 rows in all tables; SVG avatars rejected with `400`.
issues.confidenceAndStatus: 高可信度 · 已通过本地 SQLite + Worker PoC 全部复现确认

issues.evidence: Executable PoC (`evidence/security-poc-results.json`): Payloads `=CMD|' /C calc'!A0` exported unescaped across `ExportService.toCSV`, `TripPlanner.tripToCsv`, and `ExpenseSplitter.settlementsToCsv`; `s.startTime: ''` rendered raw unescaped HTML in `ExportService.toPrintableHtml()` (`window.open().document.write`).

2. Export CSV and Printable HTML (`pdf`).
issues.rootCause: CSV cell escapers only quote commas/quotes/newlines without neutralizing formula prefixes (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r`), and `toPrintableHtml` omits `escXml()` on `s.startTime`.

issues.evidence: 14-scenario cross-check vs `astronomy-engine` (`evidence/science-audit-results.json`): Reykjavik `2026-06-21` sunset jumps `+1440.4 min` (`24h` error) because `SunCalc.getTimes` lacks `utcOffset`; Ushuaia `2026-12-21` `astroDusk=null` and global no-moonrise days render `'Polar Day/Night'`; SunCalc clamps `h=0` in `astroRefraction` (`+0.12°` to `+0.28°` night bias); `terrain-3d.js` shifts flat `0°` horizon sunrise/sunset by `+2m/-3m`.
reproSteps: 1. Run `SunCalc.getTimes` on Reykjavik `2026-06-21` without `utcOffset`.
2. Check `formatTimeInOffset(null)` on Ushuaia Dec 21 `astroDusk` or Tromsø Dec 21 `moonTimes.rise`.
issues.rootCause: `PhotoSimulator` omits `SunCalc`'s `utcOffset` parameter, `formatTimeInOffset()` assumes any non-Date is `'Polar Day/Night'`, `SunCalc` applies positive horizon refraction below `0°`, and `terrain-3d.js` tests `pos.altitude > Math.max(-0.833, obsDeg)` with a coarse `5° × 28`-step `z11/z12` DEM grid.
issues.impact: 24-hour sunset jump in sub-polar summers, false `'Polar Day/Night'` labels on ordinary moonless/continuous-twilight dates, and systematic `+2m/-3m` flat-ground sunrise/sunset skew.
issues.fixRecommendation: Standardize twilight/rise/set/refraction on `vendor/astronomy.browser.min.js` (already bundled!) or pass `utcOffset` to SunCalc; distinguish `'No Rise/Set Today'`, `'Continuous Twilight'`, and `'Polar Day/Night'`; fix `terrain-3d.js` threshold to `-0.833°` when `obsDeg <= -0.833°`.

issues.evidence: Screenshot inspection (`prod-02`, `prod-03`, `prod-06`, `prod-08`, `prod-13`, `evidence/ui-mobile-audit-results.json`): (1) Top-left brand renders redundant double circle; (2) Search pill truncates `'搜索 722 城与 5,41…'` even on 1440px/2560px; (3) Accent `#B47D22` fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 (`3.56:1` white-on-gold, `2.41:1` gold-on-light-pill); (4) 7-day forecast wraps `'大部晴朗'` misaligning temperatures (`prod-06`); (5) Viewfinder top pill vertical gold divider cuts over `'40°'` and displays `海拔 0m` (`prod-08`); (6) CollabSpace circular pills wrap `'添加'`/`'发送'`/`'发起投票'` (`prod-13`).
reproSteps: 1. Inspect `prod-02`, `prod-03`, `prod-06`, `prod-08`, `prod-13` screenshots.
issues.rootCause: Fixed narrow `max-width` on search pill and buttons, missing `white-space: nowrap` on forecast/collab pills, uncalibrated `#B47D22` light-mode accent luminance, and duplicated SVG ring next to `kairos-horizontal.svg`.
issues.impact: Degrades Apple/Google-Earth-level visual refinement and fails WCAG AA normal-text contrast on active gold pills.
issues.fixRecommendation: Darken light-mode accent text/fill to `#8C5E12` (>=4.5:1 contrast), remove duplicate circle next to brand logo, widen search pill, add `white-space: nowrap` on Collab/forecast buttons, and fix Viewfinder HUD divider & elevation binding.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: WCAG AA >=4.5:1 across active pills, zero awkward 2-char vertical wrapping, zero search truncation on >=1280px desktop.

issues.evidence: Static architecture audit (`evidence/arch-and-tests-results.json`): `js/app.js` is 3,899 LOC (`bindEvents` 735 lines, nesting 8); `assets/brand/source/` contains 9 byte-for-byte duplicate `ChatGPT 图像 *.png` (~10 MB); `prologue/bgm.js` eagerly preloads `the-blue-horizon.mp3` overlapping `ambient-radio.js` Track 00; both `fuse.min.js` + `minisearch.min.js` and `suncalc.min.js` + `astronomy.browser.min.js` ship eagerly; dead symbols (`window.AppSkybox`, `#layer-meta-inspector`, `preview-primary.png`).
reproSteps: 1. Run `audit_arch.mjs` and compare hashes of `assets/brand/source/*.png`.
issues.rootCause: Iterative feature additions across V3–V5 accumulated inside `js/app.js` and `assets/` without pruning superseded utilities/assets.
issues.impact: Increases repo bloat (~10MB duplicate PNGs), increases bundle size (`SunCalc`+`Fuse` duplicate functionality), and raises long-term maintenance friction in `js/app.js`.
issues.fixRecommendation: Remove duplicate `ChatGPT 图像 *.png` & unused `preview-primary.png` / dead DOM IDs; standardize on `Astronomy Engine` & `MiniSearch`; modularize `js/app.js` `bindEvents()` and `starfield` without forcing an SPA rewrite; set `bgm.js` `preload='none'` until prologue starts.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Repo binary footprint reduced by ~10MB; `js/app.js` decomposed into clean cohesive modules; no eager duplicate audio/math libraries.
